## The Netherlands {#nl-msp-2030}

![Dutch Marine Spatial Plan for 2022-2027](images/NEDERLAND.png){fig-alt="Dutch MSP" height="600"}\](https://www.noordzeeloket.nl/beleid/programma-noordzee-2022-2027/)

The most recent MSP of the Netherlands is detailed in the Programma Noordzee 2022-2027 document. Map data is available through the Rijkswaterstaat geoserver.

## The Netherlands information on the European MSP platform

The country profile for The Netherlands is available via <https://maritime-spatial-planning.ec.europa.eu/countries/netherlands>.
